data.name: Api_global_effect
data.value: Declares the effect. Call it once per file with an object holding the name, settings and render function.

data.name: Api_global_Math
data.value: Math functions (no Math.random; use ctx.hash or ctx.random).

data.name: Api_global_lerp
data.value: The value t (0-1) of the way from a to b: a + (b - a) * t.

data.name: Api_global_hsvToRgb
data.value: Makes a color { r, g, b, a } (0-255) from hue h (0-360), saturation s and value v (0-1). a is optional (default 255).

data.name: Api_global_rgbToOklab
data.value: Turns r, g, b (0-255) into OKLab { l (lightness 0-1), a, b } (the same values as the app's OKLab math).

data.name: Api_global_oklabToRgb
data.value: Turns OKLab l, a, b into a color { r, g, b, a }. Outside sRGB it keeps lightness and hue and only reduces chroma (alpha 255).

data.name: Api_effect_name
data.value: Effect name (shown in the effect list and assets). Required.

data.name: Api_effect_author
data.value: Author name (optional). Shown in the run confirmation window.

data.name: Api_effect_description
data.value: Short description (optional, up to 200 characters). Used by the Effect Maker's description field and as the short description when you publish.

data.name: Api_effect_translations
data.value: Name, description and setting labels in other languages (language code → { name, description, labels }). The one for the UI language is shown, else the declared values.

data.name: Api_translation_name
data.value: Effect name in that language (1-100 characters).

data.name: Api_translation_description
data.value: Short description in that language (up to 200 characters).

data.name: Api_translation_labels
data.value: Setting labels in that language: setting key → label, and "key.choiceValue" → label for choices (up to 100 characters each).

data.name: Api_effect_animated
data.value: true if the look changes with frame progress (ctx.progress). Adds easing and repeat settings.

data.name: Api_effect_area
data.value: Work area: "global" (default, once per frame) or "local" (per tile, with radius px of margin).

data.name: Api_effect_radius
data.value: Margin in px around each tile when area is "local".

data.name: Api_effect_previewChick
data.value: Chick ID for the preview made when you publish (default "original").

data.name: Api_effect_previewFrames
data.value: Number of frames the effect runs in the preview and the published preview (2-20, default 10).

data.name: Api_effect_settings
data.value: Settings shown in the effects window. Read the values as s.key in render.

data.name: Api_effect_padding
data.value: Margin the effect adds outside the image: fixed [left, top, right, bottom] or a function of the settings and size.

data.name: Api_effect_render
data.value: Called for every frame; changes img.data in place. The same input must always give the same result.

data.name: Api_effect_deferred
data.value: When true, the effect draws after all other effects regardless of its place in the list (like Afterimage). Only such effects get other frames with the other effects applied through ctx.renderedFrameSource.

data.name: Api_effect_motion
data.value: When false, an animated effect doesn't use easing or repeat (for example blinking timed in frames), so the effects window hides those fields. Default true.

data.name: Api_effect_clipsBySource
data.value: When true and the effect is clipped to the previous one, img holds only the pixels the previous effect changed, and results outside that area are kept behind the picture (effects that move pixels, like Reflection). Clipped such effects still widen the padding. Otherwise only results inside the area remain.

data.name: Api_effect_erasesSource
data.value: true, or the key of a bool setting (then only while that setting is on): the effect erases the source and keeps only lines (like Outline with "Hide original"). Pixels it made transparent are removed from the area that following clipped effects use.

data.name: Api_effect_easing
data.value: Initial easing of a newly added effect (default "Linear").

data.name: Api_effect_easing_Linear
data.value: Even speed.

data.name: Api_effect_easing_EaseIn
data.value: Starts slowly.

data.name: Api_effect_easing_EaseOut
data.value: Ends slowly.

data.name: Api_effect_easing_EaseInOut
data.value: Starts and ends slowly.

data.name: Api_effect_area_global
data.value: Called once per frame with the whole image.

data.name: Api_effect_area_local
data.value: Called per tile (with radius px around it).

data.name: Api_setting_key
data.value: Storage key (starts with a letter or _). Read it as s.key in render.

data.name: Api_setting_label
data.value: Setting label.

data.name: Api_setting_type
data.value: Value kind: "int", "number", "bool", "color", "choice", "colorList", "colorPairs".

data.name: Api_setting_min
data.value: Smallest value (int, number). For colorList and colorPairs: fewest items (default 0).

data.name: Api_setting_max
data.value: Largest value (int, number). For colorList and colorPairs: most items (default 16, up to 64).

data.name: Api_setting_step
data.value: Slider step (number).

data.name: Api_setting_default
data.value: Initial value (of the right kind; colors as "#ff8800", colorList as ["#ff8800", ...], colorPairs as [{ from: "#000000", to: "#ffffff" }, ...]).

data.name: Api_setting_choices
data.value: Items of a choice: [{ value, label }].

data.name: Api_setting_alpha
data.value: When false, colors of a color, colorList or colorPairs setting have no alpha choice and are always opaque (255). Default true.

data.name: Api_setting_widget
data.value: Editor shape in the effects window (int only): "angle" shows an angle dial, "point" an X/Y point picker together with the setting named by pair.

data.name: Api_setting_pair
data.value: Y setting key (another int setting) of widget "point". This setting is X; the Y setting is edited in the same row.

data.name: Api_setting_widget_angle
data.value: Angle dial (0 = right, 90 = up).

data.name: Api_setting_widget_point
data.value: X/Y point picker (Y setting key in pair).

data.name: Api_setting_type_int
data.value: Integer: slider and number field.

data.name: Api_setting_type_number
data.value: Number: slider and number field (to the digits of step).

data.name: Api_setting_type_bool
data.value: On/off: checkbox.

data.name: Api_setting_type_color
data.value: Color: color swatch. s.key is { r, g, b, a }.

data.name: Api_setting_type_choice
data.value: Pick from a list: s.key is the chosen value string.

data.name: Api_setting_type_colorList
data.value: Color list (add, remove, reorder): s.key is [{ r, g, b, a }, ...]. Read item colors with ctx.colorAt (gradients included).

data.name: Api_setting_type_colorPairs
data.value: Color pair list (from color to color): s.key is [{ from, to }, ...]. Read item colors with ctx.pairColor (gradients included).

data.name: Api_img_width
data.value: Image width in px (including padding).

data.name: Api_img_height
data.value: Image height in px (including padding).

data.name: Api_img_data
data.value: RGBA number array (length = width * height * 4). Changing it changes the image.

data.name: Api_img_blank
data.value: Makes an empty (transparent) image of the same form.

data.name: Api_img_blendOver
data.value: Alpha-blends src over this image at (x, y).

data.name: Api_ctx_t
data.value: Progress within the effect range (0-1, before repeat and easing).

data.name: Api_ctx_phase
data.value: Progress with repeat but before easing (0-1).

data.name: Api_ctx_progress
data.value: Progress with repeat and easing (0-1). Animated effects usually use this.

data.name: Api_ctx_frame
data.value: Index of the frame being drawn (from 0).

data.name: Api_ctx_step
data.value: Frames since the first frame of the effect range (from 0).

data.name: Api_ctx_span
data.value: Length of the effect range minus 1.

data.name: Api_ctx_source
data.value: Where the original sits inside the padded image: { x, y, w, h }.

data.name: Api_ctx_pivot
data.value: Pivot position { x, y } in image coordinates.

data.name: Api_ctx_color
data.value: Color { r, g, b, a } of the color setting key at (x, y). Without a gradient it is the solid color; with one it is sampled like the official effects over the opaque bounds of the image before the effect (or over bounds { x, y, w, h } when given).

data.name: Api_ctx_colorAt
data.value: Color at (x, y) of item index of the color list setting key (same gradient rules as ctx.color).

data.name: Api_ctx_pairColor
data.value: Color at (x, y) of the "from" or "to" side of pair index of the color pair setting key (same gradient rules as ctx.color).

data.name: Api_ctx_hasGradient
data.value: Whether a color slot has a gradient: "key", list item "key[0]", pair side "key[0].from" or "key[0].to". List items can also be picked by number: ctx.hasGradient("listKey", index, "from"|"to" (pairs only)); false when there is no such item.

data.name: Api_ctx_hash
data.value: A number from 0 up to 1 fixed by position, seed and purpose (salt, default 0), independent of the frame. Different salts give unrelated values.

data.name: Api_ctx_bayer2
data.value: 2x2 ordered-dither threshold 0-3 (the pattern continues for negative coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_bayer4
data.value: 4x4 ordered-dither threshold 0-15 (the pattern continues for negative coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_random
data.value: A number from 0 up to 1 fixed by frame and seed.

data.name: Api_ctx_frameSource
data.value: The effect source of another frame (without effects, same size), or null.

data.name: Api_ctx_renderedFrameSource
data.value: Deferred effects only: another frame with this layer's other (non-deferred) effects applied, as { image, offsetX, offsetY } (position relative to the original). null when the frame has no source, its size differs or the effect is not deferred.

data.name: Api_rendered_image
data.value: The image with effects applied (including padding, a new copy on every call).

data.name: Api_rendered_offsetX
data.value: X of that image's top-left relative to the original's top-left (negative by the padding).

data.name: Api_rendered_offsetY
data.value: Y of that image's top-left relative to the original's top-left (negative by the padding).

data.name: Api_ctx_source_x
data.value: Left of the original in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_source_y
data.value: Top of the original in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_source_w
data.value: Width of the original in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_source_h
data.value: Height of the original in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_pivot_x
data.value: Pivot X (image coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_pivot_y
data.value: Pivot Y (image coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_center
data.value: Center { x, y } of the effect source (the canvas, or the part rectangle for part layers) in image coordinates. Unlike the pivot, always the center.

data.name: Api_ctx_center_x
data.value: Source center X (image coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_center_y
data.value: Source center Y (image coordinates).

data.name: Api_ctx_slice
data.value: 9-slice border { left, top, right, bottom } of the effect source in px from its edges (project border for the canvas, part border for part layers). null when there is no border, it does not fit, or outside a project.

data.name: Api_ctx_slice_left
data.value: Left border in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_slice_top
data.value: Top border in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_slice_right
data.value: Right border in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_slice_bottom
data.value: Bottom border in px.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerBelow
data.value: The layer directly below (same group and level, hidden layers count) on this frame without its effects, aligned to img (same size and position, transparent outside). null when there is no such layer or cel, or outside a project.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerAbove
data.value: The layer directly above on this frame without its effects, aligned to img. null when there is none.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerBelowWithEffects
data.value: The layer directly below with its effects for this frame, aligned to img. Effects of that layer that read other layers with effects are skipped (no cycles). null when there is none.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerAboveWithEffects
data.value: The layer directly above with its effects for this frame, aligned to img. Effects of that layer that read other layers with effects are skipped. null when there is none.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerEffectsByName
data.value: Names of the effects enabled on this frame (list order) of the layer with this name (the nearest one if several). Empty array when there is none.

data.name: Api_ctx_layerEffectsAt
data.value: Names of the effects enabled on this frame of the layer offset steps away in the same group and level (-1 = directly below, 1 = directly above, 0 = this layer). Empty array when there is none.

data.name: Api_color_a
data.value: Opacity (0-255).

data.name: Api_hsv_s
data.value: Saturation (0-1).

data.name: Api_hsv_v
data.value: Value (0-1).

data.name: Api_oklab_l
data.value: Lightness (0-1).

data.name: Api_oklab_a
data.value: Green (-) to red (+) axis.

data.name: Api_oklab_b
data.value: Blue (-) to yellow (+) axis.

data.name: Api_Math_PI
data.value: Pi.

data.name: Api_Math_E
data.value: Euler's number e.

data.name: Api_Math_abs
data.value: Absolute value.

data.name: Api_Math_floor
data.value: Rounds down.

data.name: Api_Math_ceil
data.value: Rounds up.

data.name: Api_Math_trunc
data.value: Drops the fraction (toward 0).

data.name: Api_Math_round
data.value: Rounds to nearest (.5 up).

data.name: Api_Math_sign
data.value: Sign: -1, 0 or 1.

data.name: Api_Math_min
data.value: Smallest value.

data.name: Api_Math_max
data.value: Largest value.

data.name: Api_Math_sqrt
data.value: Square root.

data.name: Api_Math_pow
data.value: x to the power y.

data.name: Api_Math_hypot
data.value: sqrt(x^2 + y^2): distance from the origin.

data.name: Api_Math_sin
data.value: Sine (radians).

data.name: Api_Math_cos
data.value: Cosine (radians).

data.name: Api_Math_tan
data.value: Tangent (radians).

data.name: Api_Math_atan2
data.value: Angle of direction (x, y) in radians (-pi to pi).

data.name: Api_Math_exp
data.value: e to the power x.

data.name: Api_Math_log
data.value: Natural logarithm.

data.value: Name in this source
